scope: Test literature-derived relative heading/goal phase structure in the modeled PFL3 population. This is not a behavior test.

literature.note: The publication favors twelve functional columns. Its nine-column alternative is used here only as a frozen sensitivity mapping because MaleCNS instance metadata resolves C1-C9.

mandatory_reports: exact PFL3 body IDs grouped by C label and instance L/R metadata
exact PB labels used by the heading crosswalk
PFL3 L/R sums versus relative phase
forbidden_selection: Do not choose structural threshold from PFL3 asymmetry magnitude.
Do not tune phase offsets using DNa02 output or navigation performance.
Do not promote the nine-column sensitivity mapping to anatomical truth because it yields a cleaner curve.
Do not add signed Delta7 dynamics without independent sign evidence.
Do not call modeled PFL3 population difference measured firing or a proven steering command.
next_gate: After E002d passes, E002e may connect the frozen PFL3 comparison readout to the separately qualified E002a steering scaffold.
claim_boundary: Passing E002d would support a deterministic literature-derived relative-phase comparison pattern in the modeled MaleCNS PFL3 population under explicit mapping assumptions. It would not establish absolute preferred angles, physiological firing, DNa02 steering, odor-source navigation, or intact-versus-rewire superiority.
